sahneler.metin: The Hubble Space Telescope was launched, and its first images came back blurry.
Suddenly, the billion-dollar observatory looked like a failure.
Its main mirror had been ground to the wrong shape.
It was polished with extreme precision against a faulty test tool.
One lens in that tool had been set in the wrong place.
Other tests hinted at the error but were dismissed.
Astronauts later installed corrective optics in orbit.
Hubble's images became some of the sharpest ever taken.

aciklama:
Hubble sent back blurry images after launch. The cause: spherical aberration from a null corrector with a misplaced lens.
